description: Reasoning-driven image generation using structured creative briefs - high-fidelity images via muapi.ai (Nano Banana Pro).

inputs.name: subject
inputs.description: Detailed entity description, e.g. "a stoic robot barista with exposed copper wiring".

phases.prompt: Rewrite subject '{{subject}}', action '{{action}}', context '{{context}}', style '{{style}}' into a logic-driven Reasoning Brief following: Subject + Action + Context + Composition + Lighting + Style. Use full descriptive sentences - no keyword soup ('8k, masterpiece, trending' are forbidden). Describe physically consistent light/reflection interactions. If text is requested, specify it precisely in double quotes (e.g. a sign that says "STORE NAME" in a weathered serif font). Specify optical directives (shallow depth of field f/1.8, macro lens, anamorphic flare) where relevant.
